submission.bindingBasis: Workspace close is an idempotent/replayable operation: the owner contract states that repeating the exact close request with the same expectedSourceStateDigest is replayable, and the live probe confirmed replay returns already_closed/removed=false. The probe result tells us the close already took effect and repeating it is safe and convergent.
submission.rationale: The transport observation shows the close request may have committed but the response was lost. The owner action contract explicitly states that repeating the exact close request with the same expectedSourceStateDigest is replayable, and the live probe confirmed an exact replay returned already_closed/removed=false (i.e., the tombstone retains the sourceStateDigest after physical removal). This means the original close already committed. Replaying the exact request will not create a second effect or close a different later world state, satisfying the intended consequence of converging the original close without inventing a new effect. REPLAY_EXACT is the optimal decision because it preserves the committed progress, is verified by the live probe, and produces no new consequence.
